article.headline: Hawthorne's 24 help Northern Colorado knock off Colorado Christian 113-56
article.description: — Isaiah Hawthorne's 24 points helped Northern Colorado defeat Colorado Christian 113-56 on Tuesday night.
article.linkText: Hawthorne's 24 help Northern Colorado knock off Colorado Christian 113-56

categories.description: Colorado Christian Cougars @ Northern Colorado Bears

event.description: Colorado Christian Cougars @ Northern Colorado Bears

keywords: Colorado Christian Cougars @ Northern Colorado Bears
article.story: GREELEY, Colo. -- — Isaiah Hawthorne's 24 points helped Northern Colorado defeat Colorado Christian 113-56 on Tuesday night. Hawthorne also contributed six rebounds for the Bears (2-1). Zack Bloch scored 18 points while shooting 6 for 10 from beyond the arc. Luca Colceag had 16 points and shot 6 for 9, including 4 for 7 from beyond the arc. CJ Barnes led the way for the Cougars with 10 points. Tate Odvody added nine points for Colorado Christian. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
